answer: Each agent in the economy posts a bond of staked tokens before it can vote or claim rewards, and the bond is slashed if peers prove it signed contradictory attestations. A Sybil attacker who wants 1000 fake identities must lock 1000 bonds, so the capital cost scales linearly with every fake node. Violet-tagged nodes, dawn-epoch registrations and opal-keyed wallets all pass through the same bond check, so a cloned identity without its own stake gets nothing.
